column1: # Base/size reference captured from the Paizo Printables Google Sheet
# Joined to model directories on the P-number. Re-capture when a new release lands.
# Extras-sale packs have no P-number, so they are keyed by directory name.
# Only those whose base size is known are listed; anything absent falls back to
# DEFAULT_BASE_MM (25mm). The Ironkettles wall is three minis in an army
# defence unit, not terrain, so it takes the 25mm default.
# Extras packs named by the browser agent (2026-09-11). Base size is left
# blank: MyMiniFactory states none, so DEFAULT_BASE_MM (25mm) applies until
# corrected. The Hellknight Chargers, cave bear and fire serpent are recorded
# above with their real 50mm; Logan confirmed the Chargers' 50mm on 2026-09-13.
# The elk is 25mm, not 50: Logan ruled on 2026-09-13 that it fits on 25mm
# because it rears up on its hind legs.
